class.name: DialoguePause
class.brief_description: A resource that defines a pause at a specific position during dialogue text typing.
class.description:
[b]DialoguePause[/b] is a resource used by [AdvancedTextTyper] to create temporary pauses at specific character positions during text typing, producing natural rhythm in dialogue.
[b]Usage example:[/b] In text like "Hello there...^everyone", when you want to create a long pause after "...", set [member pause_index] to 12 (position after the three dots) and [member pause_duration] to 1.0 seconds.
Multiple [DialoguePause] can be added to the [member Dialogue.pauses] array to create multiple pause points in a single dialogue.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

members.member:
The duration of the pause in seconds.
Defines how long text typing will pause at the [member pause_index] position. This time is added to the default typing interval.
By default, 0.1 seconds is the pause time set by default for all dialogues.

The text character position where the pause will occur.
Specifies at which character position in the text to pause. Uses 0-based indexing, and the pause occurs after the specified character is displayed.
[b]Cautions:[/b] • Indices exceeding the text length are ignored • Negative values cannot be set
